charts.title: coupled-triple-cell — behaviour over the run
charts.srcdoc:
Coupled cell — all three formalisms, all three modes

One cell running a Smoldyn particle sim, an SBML-ODE metabolism and a MaBoSS fate network, coupled by all three modes: particles catalyse the metabolism (B), the metabolite pins the fate input (A), the fate output resets the metabolism (C). Real Smoldyn + tellurium + MaBoSS.
